sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Water Release, Medical

system.description:
Your weapon weeps your blood with each swing, as the striking portion of your weapon leaves an arc of blood in its wake with each swipe. You swing with a fury only your clans ancestors can truly understand.

Make 3 melee or ranged taijutsu (or ninjutsu) attacks against a creature in range. On a hit, you deal [Weapons Damage] + 1d10 necrotic damage. Also, a damaged creature makes a Constitution saving throw, taking a -1 penalty for each successful hit you score. On a failure, affected creature gains a rank of Bleed, for each successful attack made against them.

Blood Detonation. This blood detonation effect can be triggered up to three times as part of the same casting. For every 2 Crimson Charges spent activating this effect, you can make +1 additional attack with this jutsu against the same creature.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase its damage by +1d10.
